name: Duo Security
description: Duo Security, part of Cisco, is an identity and access management platform providing multi-factor authentication, single sign-on, and device trust for securing logins.
best_for: Organizations of any size, including government agencies, that need phishing-resistant multi-factor authentication and zero-trust access controls.
features: Multi-factor authentication supporting over 1.3 billion monthly authentications
Device trust to restrict access to trusted devices
Adaptive access policies based on risk factors
Admin dashboard for policy and user management
